question:

FREE : GTHI :: GAPS : HCSW :: SOAR : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**FREE : GTHI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c30273327333ceb6e7c41ede0af3d30de36e1f0713c81cbf7ba59b6c4c316e0b.png] 

**GAPS : HCSW**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7804f8835cc30c3a654359f90709fbd39e2e5a44b6a88a069b70ee4da06fcfe7.png] 

Similarly,

**SOAR : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63b36efb8fad46e59979be439f83c8fb68fd5a0712082a5b3dd9450fae7f3753.png]
